runtime.peak_rss_units: bytes on macOS; kibibytes on Linux

semantics.binary64_merges: unequal floating representations within fixed Q12; not evidence of distinct true semantics
semantics.component_keys: fixed serialized Q12 values; never re-binned
semantics.entropy: recomputed solely from same positive source-label counts, matched against 12g display; raw entropy was not serialized
semantics.equality: raw binary64 JS equality and entropy equality do not imply equal label distributions; exact source crossproduct equality is reported separately
semantics.execution_surface: independent local CPU diagnostic with dedicated command/script/input/output hashes; no axiomdesk_run training launcher, no model calls
semantics.js_raw: serialized float.hex binary64; 12-significant-digit display never used as raw
semantics.scope: associations in fixed common-item universe; not causal attribution, label-coarseness proof, preference or model effects
